# Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Ilya Sutskever, Oriol Vinyals, Quoc V. Le  
**Year:** 2014  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1409.3215](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1409.3215)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1409.3215](https://arxiv.org/abs/1409.3215)

**Keywords:** seq2seq, machine translation

## Abstract

We present a general end-to-end approach to sequence learning that makes minimal assumptions on the sequence structure.
